audit.why: Yorick taking the lane fits a 48.65% Sejuani win rate over 111 games. Last Rites is 6s at rank 1 falling to 4 and it both heals and resets his attack, so his trade clock is roughly three times faster than Arctic Assault's 18s. Level 6 as the flip point is right because Glacial Prison's 1300 units is the first tool that reaches him from outside Dark Procession's 600-unit placement range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike names Sunfire Aegis and nothing else. Last Rites heals Yorick every time he uses it, and Grievous Wounds is absent from both layers.
audit.why: Last Rites is a 6-second heal at rank 1 that drops to 4, so it is running roughly every second trade in a lane where the entry's whole plan is to survive to items. Anti-heal is a bigger swing here than a second bulk component, and it is the buy that makes the Sunfire pattern the entry already recommends actually stick.
audit.corrected: Buy Grievous Wounds alongside the first tank item — Last Rites heals him on a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 second cycle.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (Last Rites: 'deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself', cd 6/5.5/5/4.5/4)

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer says Dark Procession will leave you 'stunned inside it with a ghoul pack on top of you' and calls it a cage that 'locks you in'. Dark Procession does not stun and does not apply any crowd control. It is a destructible wall that blocks movement, and Yorick has no hard CC anywhere in his kit.
audit.why: This is the matchup's defining ability and the entry gets its category wrong, which changes the correct response entirely. A stun is something you wait out; a destructible wall is something you attack. The full layer already says 'sidestep or break it', so the two layers disagree — and the content layer's version is what convinces a player to stand still inside a wall he could have hit twice and walked through. It also matters that no part of Yorick's kit can actually hold Sejuani still: the danger is being walled off, not being locked down.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession is a destructible wall on 20/18/16/14/12s — it does not stun. Attack a segment to break out; nothing in Yorick's kit applies hard CC.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (Dark Procession: 'summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement', cd 20/18/16/14/12; no hardCC flag anywhere in the kit)

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry calls Last Rites 'his E' in the Level 1-2 spike and refers to 'his E slash' spawning ghouls. Last Rites is Yorick's Q. His E is Mourning Mist, which is never named or described anywhere in either layer.
audit.why: Two separate abilities are collapsed into one wrong slot, and the one that goes missing is the one that decides the fight. Mourning Mist reduces armour, damages, slows and marks a target, and Riot's text says summoned units gain move speed when moving toward marked targets — that mark is why the ghoul swarm suddenly converges on you, and it is on 12/11/10/9/8 seconds. The entry describes the ghouls arriving as though it were ambient pressure rather than a single, dodgeable, trackable projectile. Fury of the North also matters here: Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, so the Mourning Mist slow does nothing on an out-of-combat Sejuani, and only the mark and the armour shred land.
audit.corrected: Last Rites is his Q. His E is Mourning Mist — 12/11/10/9/8s, a projectile that shreds armour and marks you so every Mist Walker sprints at you. Dodge the globule and the swarm never arrives; Frost Armor makes you immune to its slow anyway.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (Last Rites is slot Q; Mourning Mist is slot E, cd 12/11/10/9/8, 'reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets')
champ-data/_kits/sejuani.json (Fury of the North grants immunity to slows)

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is named as the matchup-defining cooldown in six places and no number is given for it, or for Mourning Mist, or for Eulogy of the Isles.
audit.why: 'Respect the cage cooldown obsessively' is the entry's core instruction and it never says what that cooldown is. Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12, Mourning Mist is 12/11/10/9/8, and Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100 — the longest ultimate cooldown in the matchup, which is what makes the side-lane Maiden threat periodic rather than permanent.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession 20/18/16/14/12s, Mourning Mist 12/11/10/9/8s, Last Rites 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, Eulogy of the Isles 160/130/100s.

notes: Best find: the content layer says Dark Procession will leave you 'stunned inside it'. It applies no crowd control at all — Riot's text calls it 'a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement', and no ability in Yorick's kit carries a hardCC flag. The category error changes the correct response from waiting to attacking, and the full layer already says 'sidestep or break it', so the two layers of the same page disagree and the content one is wrong. Second: Last Rites is called 'his E' in the Level 1-2 spike and 'his E slash' in wants.foe[0]. Last Rites is his Q. His actual E, Mourning Mist, appears nowhere in either layer — and it is the ability that decides the fight, because it marks you and Riot's text says summoned units gain move speed moving toward marked targets. The ghoul swarm converging on you is not ambient pressure, it is one dodgeable 12-second projectile, and the entry never tells the player that. Third: Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, so Mourning Mist's slow does nothing to an out-of-combat Sejuani — only the mark and the armour shred land. Fourth: Last Rites heals on a 6-second cycle at rank 1 and Grievous Wounds is absent from both layers.
